note: Recorded 13 Nov 2026 by tests/make_us_power_fixtures.py; nothing edited by hand. Real responses and real items only.

files.blackout-us-power.json: Blackout's two BO-IND-14 items (California 13,723 and New York 12,724 meters without power), made by Blackout's own code (blackout/odin.py and feed.py at Blackout c553b20) from the ODIN responses Blackout recorded at 14:40 UTC 13 Nov 2026 (its tests/fixtures/odin; nothing in them edited). No state was over the 50,000 line then, so the line was lowered to 10,000 for the recording, as Blackout's own test does; every number is ODIN's. Each item carries its state's EAGLE-I base rate as Blackout attaches it.
files.cop-2026-11-13-us.json: COP's archived snapshot of 20:21 UTC 13 Nov 2026 (release snapshots-2026-11, 2026-11-13.geojson.gz): its health block, every Elements item in or near the US (106, including the Winter Storm and High Wind Warnings in California and Alaska's Blizzard Warning), and the first two Cordon notices and Watchfloor items, none of which name the US. The Blackout reading is 5 h 41 min older than the snapshot; Blackout reads ODIN every 4 hours, so a reading that age can sit in a snapshot when a run is late.
files.cop-volcano-days.json: Every Elements volcano item (USGS) from each of COP's 14 archived days, 31 Oct to 13 Nov 2026, with that day's health block. Kilauea raised from Advisory/Yellow to Watch/Orange in the 3 Nov copy and lowered back in the 7 Nov copy; Great Sitkin at Watch/Orange throughout.
files.cop-spc-days.json: Every SPC Day 1 risk area (Elements) from the 9 archived days that had one.
